question: Should completion delivery treat only exact requester-route evidence as visible success, accepting that ambiguous or wrong-target evidence will now invoke fallback or report failure?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and delivery-semantics choice: the implementation can prevent false acknowledgements, but maintainers must decide whether the resulting fallback/failure behavior is the desired product contract for existing deployments.

options.title: Approve exact route evidence
options.body: Accept the conservative delivery contract, rebase onto current main, and merge only after the current merge result confirms the focused route and fallback cases.

options.title: Preserve broad acknowledgement
options.body: Keep legacy success accounting for ambiguous evidence and close or redesign this change if avoiding new fallback/failure outcomes takes priority.

recommendation.title: Approve exact route evidence
recommendation.body: Accept the conservative delivery contract, rebase onto current main, and merge only after the current merge result confirms the focused route and fallback cases.
